notes.title: Important Announcement! Read this before playing the demo or purchasing the game
notes.content:
Hello friends,  

We have both good and bad news for you.  

1) [b]The good news[/b] is that, thanks to the tremendous support from [b]Meta[/b] (which we can't talk about in detail just yet), we are still actively working on the full version of the game. So far, we have completely reworked the first three original locations, adding a lot of new mini-games and optional activities. Additionally, we have introduced two more boss fights, and we plan to add two more by the time of the full release. We are also actively testing multiplayer, featuring four different multiplayer modes. While not all of them may make it into the final version, there is also a possibility that we will add even more multiplayer modes. All of this will be included in the final version of the game.  

2) [b]The bad news[/b] is that you will have to wait a bit longer for us to complete and release the full version on Steam. We hope to finish it by the end of this year.  

[h3]Why we ask you to read this message before purchasing the game or playing the demo:[/h3]  
We are aware that many players struggle to understand the core mechanics of the Magnetic Stick in our game. In the full version, [b]we have completely revamped the tutorial to help all players grasp the mechanics as quickly as possible[/b]. To ensure you get the best possible experience and don't get the wrong impression of the game, we encourage you to add it to your Wishlist and wait for the full release.  

If you have already purchased the game and supported us—[u][b]thank you so much![/b][/u] [u][b]We truly appreciate your support![/b][/u] When the full version is released, we will increase the price, but those who purchased the Early Access version will receive a free upgrade to the full version. This means you’ll get even more content at no additional cost, in addition to everything you already have.  

Best regards,  
Gentlemen Studio

notes.title: Update 0.8025
notes.content: We have added [b]5 new difficulty levels[/b] (Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare). Now you can adjust the game's difficulty to your liking. The difficulty levels do not affect platforming; they weaken or strengthen monsters and bosses. You can [b]change the difficulty at any time[/b] in the main menu or pause menu, and [b]it will instantly alter your enemies' attributes[/b].

notes.title: Update 0.8023
notes.content:
[b]Boss Fight:[/b]
Challenge the [b]second boss[/b] which can be found in the second level, and try to defeat him to unlock the entrance to the next location.
Use the magic power and move fast to avoid all his minions!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
1) you can select another controls preset
2) you can disable ambient occlusion (to fix the problem with weird shadows if they disturbed you)
3) now you can use a magnet stick to magnetize dragon eggs
4) you can switch difficulties in the trolley section

notes.title: Update 0.8022
notes.content: We have [b]added Sticks Store[/b] and first skins which you can unlock with the Dragon Eggs. Also we have fixed problem with sounds when you minimize the game

notes.title: Update 0.8021
notes.content:
We've added dragon egg pickups. Try to find and collect them all! You must be attentive because some of them are very well hidden, and to reach others, you will need to try hard!

Also we fixed a lot of small bugs, changed the "Virtual Hands Calibration" system, make some late game moments easier.

notes.title: Update 0.8020
notes.content: Added a possibility to [b]calibrate virtual hands[/b], added a [b]speed modifier setting for the fluent rotation[/b], added a possibility to [b]replay completed levels.[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.8019
notes.content: [b]Fixed Pico controllers position.[/b] If you use Pico headset, then open the Controls menu and switch the "Pico Headset" parameter

notes.title: Update 0.8018
notes.content:
Challenge the [b]first boss[/b] in the Village, and try to defeat him to unlock the entrance to the next location.
Use the full power of first sticks, and [b]be quick to avoid all his attacks![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.8015
notes.content: [b]Added per level statistics, fixed problems with input when use Virtual Desktop[/b]
